items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and approve no new spend, monetization, telemetry, requeues, or forecasts. Amazon reports $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 under an unattributed aggregate row; named site rows show clicks but $0 attributed commission. AI spend is $916.91 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 39 instrumented sites, including $143.69 for 0daynews.com, $98.55 for americastrikes.com, and $66.06 for blackmarketapparel.com. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because matching-period infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment, commitment, budget-ceiling, and learning-threshold data are absent. Continue only existing reconciliation, measurement, repair-or-close, legal, security, and parked-site work. Retain the $4.92 as unattributed and reject revenue or causal-lift claims.

Continue the existing matching-period finance reconciliation only. Minimum measurement required for contribution margin and cost-to-learn: provider-level revenue identifiers by site/content and matching-period ledger entries for AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, experiments, commitments, and budgets, plus an explicit cost-to-learn threshold. Until then, SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions remain operating indicators, not financial outcomes; 36 improvements awaiting measurement and 3 proven outcomes do not support a portfolio forecast.

The two already-queued private readiness repairs may continue only within their existing reversible scopes and without financial claims or new spend. Preserve parked/private status, record exact before/after artifacts and deterministic validation, and do not treat readiness-check results, traffic, conversions, or missing revenue data as evidence of contribution margin or payback.
